subChunks.soloPracticeHtml:
Solo practice

On your own, find a real or imagined case where module 38: cyberpsychology matters. Analyse it using the module vocabulary, then decide what extra evidence you would need.

Do this without using the guided steps as a template. Afterwards, compare your answer with the lesson and mark one thing to improve.
